rationale: PR #339 proved customer-relevant qualifications and internal diagnostics are collapsed at the human response surface. This change reuses governed semantic attributes already carried by approved findings to emit evidence-locked CUSTOMER_QUALIFICATION and NEXT_STEP sections, while preserving raw response limitations in provenance and retaining legacy fallback behavior.
authority_impact: No reasoning, decision, certification, or publication authority changes. Customer communication text must originate in governed publication semantic attributes with evidence references and is fidelity-checked before response assembly.
